description.text: Team assembly work means team members jointly assembling a complete product or its components, being able to perform all tasks in the team assembly process and rotating through all or most tasks rather than permanently doing one action. The work includes checking order drawings, quality inspection, wiring harness assistance, equipment cleaning, and production reports; members may join task assignment and training, including team leaders who work within the team. A team leader does not automatically equal an independent first-line supervisor, and maintenance or forklift mentions in the task profile grant no actual operating qualification. This page freezes 51-2092.00; the BLS wage and projection figures use the 51-2090 miscellaneous assembler combined reference, which includes other assemblers, and cannot be split into precise team data. China's real equipment, post training, special operation conditions, protection, and contracts are checked separately. Entirely fictional paper supporting records only look at rules, quantities, versions, and unknowns, and do not start machines, touch real electrical welding or forklifts, or grant quality release.
